title: Resolve first synthetic UX findings and verify the revised journey
body:
## Outcome
Close the highest-impact observed journey problems with before/after evidence.
## Delivery
Status: In progress — no longer blocked: #26 is closed and its findings are triaged. Of the selected findings, two are delivered (wording #46 and the phone overflow, both in #47) and one is in progress (continuity #45, Codex, PR #51). **Remaining:** verification at the new exact build after #45 merges, and the iteration retrospective. The verifier is unclaimed; per #23, the OpenAI/OpenClaw verification lane.
Previous status (superseded 8 November 2026): Blocked
Priority: P0
Iteration: Next
Role: builder then independent verifier; unclaimed
Dependencies: #26 and its triaged finding issues.
## Acceptance
- Coordinator selects concrete P0/P1 findings and bounded visual improvements from the report; do not invent defects or pre-close the report.
- Each selected finding has a linked PR and task/variant reproduction. New lower-priority scope becomes a separate issue.
- Builder performs the visual-polish loop on every affected frontend flow.
- Verifier reruns affected tasks and adjacent controls against the new exact build; distinguish a primed regression from a fresh unprimed usability attempt.
- Report fixed, still failing and blocked findings with evidence; update capability/readiness records only when demonstrated.
- Iteration retrospective records what changed and the next priority; human approval #8 and research #9 stay independent.

## Reconciliation against merged #47–#49 — 8 November 2026
By Claude (`claude-reconcile-20261108`) on Nissan's instruction. Verified on `main` at `0a7d9a6` from a fresh clone ([evidence](https://github.com/nissan/oz-startup-brain/issues/23#issuecomment-6714202965); builder-run, not independent). Nothing was rebuilt.

| Finding (from the 7 November comment above) | Status |
| --- | --- |
| 1. Follow-up context continuity (T03/T05), medium | **#45**: Codex, design under review in PR #51 |
| 2. Requirement/preparation wording and terms, low | **Delivered** in #47 (#46); ready to close |
| 3. Gympie directory overflow at 390px, medium | **Delivered** in #47 (`ae2ea97`); e2e "Gympie static directory remains readable without horizontal overflow at 390px in both themes" passes at `0a7d9a6` |

**Still to do here:**
- After #45 merges, rerun T03 and T05, plus T01 as the adjacent control, at the exact merged build. Keep primed regressions separate from fresh actors.
- Re-check fixture readiness for T01/T03/T05 at the merged build (carried from #41).
- Update capability records only where shown.
- Write the iteration retrospective.

T13 (#53) and #9 are separate.
